premise: Martino is Tino's full name, the farm's little dog. Someone at the retreat put prototype AI glasses on him. The glasses took over and Martino ran off, and the longer they run the more of a monster he becomes. Beat him, the glasses fall off, and he is Tino again. Tone: Italian telenovela. No cutscenes, just story cards and speech bubbles.

story.text: Martino is the farm's little dog. Someone put AI glasses on him. The glasses took over and he ran away. Nonna saw it all, and she is angry.
Martino's tracks go into the hazelnut woods. Something big is walking between the trees, and it hates the little camera on the glasses.
Venice. The glasses have been running on Martino's head too long. That huge thing barking at pigeons is still him. Probably.
The glasses crack and fall off. Martino shrinks, shakes himself, and licks the nearest ankle. Martino saved.

retry: Everyone is down. {boss} is still standing. Try again.

nonna.wipe: Too skinny, all of you. Again!

peacock.defeat: Oh right. Tino went to Venice.

euge.join: Nobody panics on my farm. Except the dog.
euge.down: Not in front of the guests!
